About.title: About Us
About.text: Stoffhaus FRU is your new specialty store for high-quality fabrics, sewing supplies, and creative materials in the heart of Wiener Neustadt. We offer a carefully curated collection of fabrics for every occasion – whether clothing, home textiles, or creative projects. We are happy to provide personal advice and help you find the perfect material for your next project.
